This contract restates only the members this key reads and declares no admin operation of its own.

The operation of 12.1 is the one-hop REST operation on the rwb-agent contract that starts a TDR suggestion run. The rwb-treatment and rwb-agent owners agree it, and at the wave 2 contract review they fix the caller-side operation, the request members and the treatment columns that hold the proposal and the model, prompt and policy versions; until then those not named in this document are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1882). The decision codes of an override and of a fallback are recorded with rwb-decision before the story's Done; their values are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1882). The types of the answer members and of the record members are agreed with the record owner; where this document does not give them they are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0634). The QA lead fixes the harness environment, the TDR model stub controls, the evidence format and the gate at the wave 2 entry check; until then they are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0414).
